name: SPT-CL J2306-2215 (Hubble)
blurb: SPT-CL J2306-2215, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: sptclj23062215-hubble
story: SPT-CL J2306-2215 is one of the massive galaxy clusters in the SPT catalog of more than 500 systems found through the Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect. Hubble imaged it to follow how the giant galaxies at cluster centers grow and how clusters act as gravitational lenses.

claims.text: SPT-CL J2306-2215 is a target of an HST survey of massive SPT galaxy clusters
The SPT catalog has more than 500 systems identified via the Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect
Goals include brightest cluster galaxy evolution and strong lensing
